---
name: Idea
about: Propose something to test on this task
title: "Idea: "
labels: idea
---

**Hypothesis** (one sentence: what improves, for whom, by roughly how much)

**Mechanism** (why it should work on cued, class-balanced 4-second windows, one at a time, no labels at test time)

**Cheapest test** (the smallest experiment that could show it is wrong)

**What is already known** (the closest entries in docs/IDEAS_TRIED.md, and what is different here)
